ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-grey) central surface with low-intensity (black) borders and focal splotches; approximately 85% high-intensity to 15% low-intensity distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central lobes; continuous low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; focal dark pigmentation blobs concentrated at the inferior peduncle-notch intersection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 95-degree interior angle and significant vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire trailing edge; highest amplitude variations located near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curve from the central notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a distinct concave sweep at the terminal distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark, textured clusters of high-contrast pixels located at the extreme terminal tips of both lobes, creating a rough, jagged boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical linear disruption with a reddish-brown hue visible on the upper mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent reddish vertical scratch on the right fluke lobe; localized dark pigment splotches near the inferior center notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'hooked' distal tip geometry with concentrated dark pigmentation and extremely irregular edge topography.
